dedupe_keys.name: envi met simulation dataset for via milano pescara urban microclimate current and 2050 scenarios

description: This dataset contains the full ENVI-met simulation outputs and model files for a microclimate assessment of Via Milano in Pescara, Italy, carried out for an urban regeneration project to improve thermal comfort in a public space next to a school. It was published on 4 May 2026 by Graziano Enzo Marchesani and Roberta Cocci Grifoni of the Università di Camerino, following the method of the Life AGREENET project. Four runs form a two-by-two matrix: before and after the intervention, under the current climate and a 2050 projection. The intervention adds layered green infrastructure along the street (trees, an aromatic shrub layer and permeable paving that removes asphalt); the 2050 case offsets the baseline with regional climate projections, and the design day of 21 July 2019 was chosen by a representative-day algorithm. Outputs include air temperature, mean radiant temperature, wind speed, humidity and the Universal Thermal Climate Index. Access: open download from Zenodo; models were built with a scripted ENVI-met automation protocol. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free, though ENVI-met itself is commercial. Caveats: one street and one design day. Simulation uses are evaluating street greening for heat adaptation in public spaces. Related records: the Naples climate shelters case study and the URBREATH 3-30-300 rasters.
